title: Newspaper should apologize
article: A letter from Mike Hulley Sr., Kingston.
I am writing to protest the appalling headline and photo The Whig-Standard ran in reporting on the death of Samuel Truscott.

Shame on The Whig. This was a troubled human being who left behind grief-stricken family members and friends. Where was The Whig's respect for human dignity when it dredged up a seven-year- old photo and splashed it across the front page?
I can't imagine the pain The Whig's actions inflicted upon an already distraught family. The newspaper owes them and its readers an apology for this tasteless behaviour.
